dashboard: Fleet home for Hypercluster Desktop — registered clusters and deploy shortcuts.
cluster: Cluster cockpit — open a selected cluster into overview and day-2 tabs.
studio-hub: Create Cluster hub — pick Kubernetes, virtualization, AI, or edge intent.
operations: Advanced Day-2 operations against the selected cluster.
settings: Desktop app settings, providers, and trial/license status.
copilot: Ask Zeus / Copilot overlay for cluster-grounded assistance.
studio: Full Cluster Studio wizard (nodes → storage → network → validate → deploy).
quick-deploy: Opinionated quick path for a standard cluster profile.
deploy: Live deploy console — pipeline logs and stage status.
cluster/overview: Cluster overview — health, version, and capacity summary.
cluster/nodes: Node inventory, SSH status, and scale actions.
cluster/workloads: Workloads running on the provisioned cluster.
cluster/vms: KubeVirt VMs when virtualization add-ons are installed.
cluster/platform: Zyvor platform components installed on the cluster.
cluster/instruments: Instrument / telemetry panels for the cluster.
cli/provision: CLI deploy / wizard / profiles for bare-metal Kubernetes.
cli/lifecycle: Scale, upgrade, destroy, unlock via hypercluster CLI.
cli/ssh: SSH, jump hosts, kubeconfig fetch/merge, API tunnels.
cli/discover: Discovery sources and preflight checks before deploy.
cli/health: health / status / test / forge-handoff JSON ops.
cli/zyvor-handoff: Hand off a ready cluster to the Zyvor product stack.
